notes.title: Kana no Mado - Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where restarting a Katakana practice session at the end of the quiz would incorrectly start a Hiragana session. Restart now always resumes the same practice mode that was just completed.
[*] Improved internal mode sync on scene start to prevent rare mismatches between selected mode and displayed content.
[/list]

notes.title: Kana no Mado - Version 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674245/dd59f4d50c16c2b60bdc38852ed5910671f09f16.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The new version 1.1.0 introduces additional options in the [b]Options[/b] menu:[/p][list][*][p]Display Mode: [i]Windowed, Borderless Window, Fullscreen[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Resolution Presets: [i]Support for both 16:9 and 16:10 monitors[/i] [/p][/*][/list][p]This should make the game more comfortable to play across a wider range of screens and setups, including ultrawide and Steam Deck.  
[/p][h3]📌 How to use[/h3][p]Open the game, go to [b]Menu → Options[/b], and choose the configuration that best fits your screen. 
[/p][h3]🛠️ More improvements coming soon[/h3][p] Thanks again for your feedback! I’m continuing to work on further improvements. [/p]
